title: editor.render.requested payload (command)
description: Command issued by the Studio-hosted media editor (via the BFF) to flatten an edit timeline into a new rendition. Consumed by MTS, which renders it and emits transcode.completed. Design: docs/architecture/services/media-editor.md.

sourceAssetId.description: Asset whose renditions the timeline references.

targetAssetId.description: Existing asset to add the rendered result to as a new version; absent = create a new asset.

mediaKind.description: The editor operates on video, audio, or image (basic-NLE, D3).

timeline.description: The edit decision list: an ordered set of clips (source in/out → timeline position) plus optional transitions and filters. Interpreted by the render worker; the authoritative shape is the EditProject timeline (media-editor.md §3).

renditionRef.description: File/rendition of the source asset this clip draws from.

outputProfile.description: MTS profile id (Tier-1 registry) to encode the flattened result with.

requestedBy.description: User id who triggered the render.
